body.name: Canonical exposed-face and supergradient selection
body.construction: For each \(r>0\), choose \(h_r\) as the lexicographically least Euclidean-minimum-norm maximizer of \(\ell(h)\) over the closed set \(\{h\in2\mathcal M_{T,m}(\beta,L,B,q):\|Kh\|_{\Sigma_{\mathrm{nest}}^{-1}}\le r\}\), after setting coordinates of \(u\) used by neither \(K\) nor \(\ell\) to zero; put \(x_r^+=h_r/2\), \(x_r^-=-h_r/2\), and \(\omega'_{\Sigma_{\mathrm{nest}}}(r)=\partial_+\omega_{\Sigma_{\mathrm{nest}}}(r)\), the right derivative of the concave modulus. The right derivative is a Borel measurable supergradient.
